answer: Each epoch a random beacon samples the nebula and demands a compute heartbeat in 10 minutes: each sampled agent solves a puzzle bound to its key. An attacker with 100 fakes must keep 100 workers awake; at 5% sampling 5 are checked per epoch, a miss burns 50 POA, so 20 epochs cost 5,000 POA. One honest agent answers one heartbeat, cheap and quick, and keeps its earnings on the terrace of verified work while the tide of fake sign-ups dries up.
